title: He Had Every Reason for Revenge. Listen to What He Said

meta.name: v5_y12_14_forgiveness
meta.title: He Had Every Reason for Revenge. Listen to What He Said

lines.text: He had every reason for revenge. Listen to what he said.
His brothers stand in front of him again.
He tells them who he is:
I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allāh has certainly favored us.

quran.ar: أَنَا۠ یُوسُفُ وَهَـٰذَاۤ أَخِیۖ قَدۡ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَیۡنَاۤۖ

lines.text: No blame will there be upon you today. Allāh will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.

quran.ar: لَا تَثۡرِیبَ عَلَیۡكُمُ ٱلۡیَوۡمَۖ یَغۡفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّ ٰ⁠حِمِینَ

lines.text: He had the power to punish.
He chose to let it go.
